change: Consolidated hardened M3 RAM-boot build fixing every runtime issue observed in v5.6.0 physical boot log and parallel full-stack code audit: (1) guard sk_pacing_shift_update for Linux 4.14.187 (sole missing symbol blocking rtl8192cd.ko load) + fail-closed ELF32-LE SHN_UNDEF vs vmlinux __ksymtab verifier; (2) enable CONFIG_RTL_SHRINK_MEMORY_SIZE=y with 256 TX/RX rings and 2600B RX SKBs (fits 64 MiB DDR2 + initramfs without order-10 GFP_ATOMIC OOM); (3) enable coherent TXBD/TXDESC/beacon DMA for RTL8814B and fix MIPS32 >>32 UB, InterruptMaskExt typo, GIMR BIT(29) post-request_irq unmask lifecycle, 0xB8000064 readback fence, colon-MAC/fallback tolerance in cfg loader, and mibstr buffer bounds; (4) synchronize PCIe0 PWRCR/PERST# reset with readback fences and 3-attempt bounded retry (eliminates LTSSM 0x0c454504 Polling.Config race); (5) silence steady-state rtl819x DP poll#/isr# UART spam via dp_heartbeat=0; (6) fix rtl8192cd.sh 2ndchoffset/psk-mixed encmode=4/explicit MIB defaults and patch LuCI wireless.js with rtl8192cd WPA2/PSK modes; all 6 MTDs stay read-only, pcie1/LEDs disabled, persistent flash NO-GO
